subject: general
question: Two pipes, A and B, can fill a tank of 1000 litres in 5 hours and 6 hours, respectively. If they are opened together, how many hours will they take to fill an empty tank of 1800 litres?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Pipe A fills 1000 L in 5 hr = 1000/5 = 200 L/hr

Pipe B fills 1000 L in 6 hr = 1000/6 = 500/3 L/hr

Combined rate = 200 + 500/3 = 1100/3 L/hr

Time for 1800 L = 1800 ÷ (1100/3) = 5400/1100

⇒ Time = 54/11 hours

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

Pipe A can fill the tank in 5 hours.

Pipe B can fill the tank in 6 hours.

Capacity of the tank = 1000 litres.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by A and B together in 1 hour = Work done by A in 1 hour + Work done by B in 1 hour

Time taken to fill the tank together = Total capacity / Work done by A and B together in 1 hour

**Calculation:**

Work done by A in 1 hour = 1000 / 5 = 200 litres/hour

Work done by B in 1 hour = 1000 / 6 = 166.67 litres/hour

Work done by A and B together in 1 hour = 200 + 166.67

Work done by A and B together in 1 hour = 366.67 litres/hour

Time taken to fill 1800 litres = 1800 / 366.67

Time taken to fill 1800 litres = (1800)/(366.67)

Time taken to fill 1800 litres = (1800 × 3)/(1100)

Time taken to fill 1800 litres = (5400)/(1100)

Time taken to fill 1800 litres = (54)/(11) hours

**The correct answer is option 1.**
